caption:
AI made content free. That made attention expensive.

Anyone can now produce 20 posts before lunch. So the feed is flooded, and every post competes with more noise than ever.

When something becomes free, the value moves somewhere else. In content, it moved to taste:
→ Knowing which idea is actually new
→ Knowing which hook a real person would stop for
→ Knowing what to cut
→ Knowing when NOT to post

The winners aren't the ones posting the most. They're the ones whose posts feel picked, not produced.

Use AI to make 20 options. Use your judgment to publish 1.

📌 Send this to the friend who's posting 3 AI carousels a day and wondering why nothing works.
